messages:
Maya: FYI OpenSSL libssl CVE (CVE-2026-XXXX) showed up in ubuntu:24.04 patch. Need a safe plan for base-image rebuilds, attestation, and how Dedicated/Private installs handle KMS failures.

security-bot: CVE-2026-XXXX - libssl information disclosure. Severity: HIGH. https://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2026-XXXX

Samir: Do we want to do a full base rebase and rebuild of downstream images, or patch in-place where possible? Rebase safer but huge churn.

Liz: I vote for rebuild + CI attest/sign flow. We should gate promotion on successful attestation + audit log entry. Only release-managers can bypass via RBAC. :+1:

Henry: How are we handling customer KMS rotations? If a customer-managed KMS key rotates mid-rollout, agents might fail verification. Need grace mode.

Maya: Proposal: agent verification_mode = STRICT | GRACE. Hosted default = STRICT. Dedicated/Private default = GRACE (opt-in STRICT per org via console). GRACE allows signature validation to pass if KMS lookup times out but records audit flag.

Samir: GRACE for on-prem makes sense. But we must record which promotions used GRACE. Add a promoted_by/audit_trace in the event metadata.

Liz: Agreed. Promotion event schema: image, tag, signer_id, attestation_status, verification_mode, actor, audit_trace_id. We'll require signer_id in allowed_signers list per org.

ops-bot: Canary suggestion: 1% traffic 3h, then 10% 12h, then 50% 24h. Auto-rollback if error rate >= 2% or token-generation latency p95 +30%.

Maya: Also need emergency rollback that does not depend on KMS calls in case we can't talk to KMS.

Henry: Implement local trusted cache for attestation metadata signed by our KMS. Agents consult cache if central KMS unreachable. Cache TTL = 1h, invalidated on key-rotation webhook. Cache updates must be pushed from control plane only.

Samir: Cache invalidation must be RBAC-protected. Only groups: infra, release-managers can push invalidation.

Liz: Draft verify script for CI gate:

```
# verify-attest.sh
STATUS=$(curl -sS "$ATTESTATION_URL/verify?image=$IMAGE_TAG" | jq -r '.status')
SIGNER=$(curl -sS "$ATTESTATION_URL/verify?image=$IMAGE_TAG" | jq -r '.signed_by')
if [ "$STATUS" != "OK" ]; then
  echo "attestation failed"; exit 2
fi
if ! echo "$ALLOWED_SIGNERS" | grep -q "$SIGNER"; then
  echo "unauthorized signer: $SIGNER"; exit 3
fi
```

Maya: CI must also require a promotion audit_trace_id and include the verification_mode used.

security-bot: Prioritize images: 1) runtime base, 2) model-serving runtime, 3) devx images. Runtime base rebuild is P0.

Samir: Owners: Samir (rebuild orchestration), Liz (CI + audit schema), Henry (KMS + cache), Maya (policy + customer communications). Target: staging rebuilds by 1969070000, production rollout starting 1969150000.

ops-bot: I'll create canary pipelines and add eng-oncall for the windows.

Liz: RBAC: only group 'release-managers' can toggle verification_mode or invalidate cache. All toggles must generate audit events with actor, timestamp, and reason.

Samir: I'll write the rollback runbook covering: KMS outage path, attestation mismatch, and regressed performance. Include commands to revert tag and to disable new image in load balancer.

Maya: I'll draft customer comms and opt-in flow for STRICT mode on Dedicated. If no objections I'll kick off staging rebuilds tomorrow. :rocket:

Henry: :thumbsup:
